purpose: Proves three related resolveStringExpr fallbacks found scanning production services: struct-literal-parameter propagation for a generic data-driven registrar helper (keyed and positional literal forms), package-level pseudo-const var resolution (never trusting a var that is reassigned anywhere in its package), and string-concatenation resolution combining both.

expectedUnresolved.note: Method: Mutable, a package-level var that IS reassigned elsewhere in its package (Reassign) — must never be trusted.
